inference_policy.coil: Shallow whorl-relief fossil solid. WWI0.86 used only as approximate outer-whorl depth relation. Central whorls are filled mineral, no tunnel.
inference_policy.shaft: Elliptical smooth transverse interpolation; nominal max width32mm, narrow ratio9.4/10.5 gradually approaches1.0; extrema locations inferred, not measured.
inference_policy.reverse: Conservative mirror of volumetric construction, explicitly unobserved.
inference_policy.fracture: Oblique filled mineral break surface; no hollow aperture.
